environment.gc: enabled; collected before each measured batch
environment.io: warm OS page cache; no fsync; final buffer drain included
environment.memory: fresh-process Linux RSS, including native allocations

attribution.profile_caveat: Instrumented timings are attribution, not SDK latency.
attribution.stage_caveat: Isolated operations, not additive pipeline timings; fixed timestamp and scalar objects; no writer in native_ingest/native_publish.

comparison.before: Preserved first-optimized native wheel; same binary as logging-100-metrics.json
comparison.after: Direct scalar serialization, shared owned vectors, native observed admission, NumPy float64 normalization, deque/shared metadata series, direct single-row and vectored batch writes
comparison.method: 20 workloads, five alternating paired rounds, 200 fresh-process trials; identical interpreter/dependencies/corpus; no concurrent builds/tests/profiles
